findings.evidence: Mathlib `Algebra/Order/Group/PosPart.lean` defines `posPart`/`negPart` (additive of `oneLePart`/`leOnePart`); `WeilDivisor/Order.lean:117,127,137,164,172` use `coeff_posPart`, `isEffective_posPart`, `support_posPart_disjoint_negPart`, `degree_posPart_sub_degree_negPart`, `posPart_pointDifference`. Naming rubric: consistency with adjacent declarations and standard Mathlib terminology.
findings.fix: Rename throughout to `posPart`/`negPart` (e.g. `EffectiveDivisorOfDegree.posPart`, `coeff_posPart`, `posPart_pointDifference`), matching Mathlib and `WeilDivisor.Order`.
findings.issue: All new declarations use `positivePart`/`negativePart`, but the object they package is Mathlib's lattice `posPart`/`negPart` (notation `⁺`/`⁻`), and the source file `WeilDivisor/Order.lean` already names its API `posPart`/`negPart` (e.g. `coeff_posPart`, `isEffective_posPart`, `support_posPart_disjoint_negPart`, `degree_posPart_sub_degree_negPart`). The new file even calls those `posPart` lemmas while renaming its own wrappers, so `posPart` and `positivePart` denote the same thing within one file. Affects `positivePart`, `negativePart`, `coe_positivePart`, `coe_negativePart`, `coeff_positivePart`, `coeff_negativePart`, `coe_positivePart_sub_coe_negativePart`, `degree_positivePart_sub_degree_negativePart`, `support_positivePart_disjoint_negativePart`, `positivePart_coe_of_isEffective`, `negativePart_coe_of_isEffective`, `positivePart_pointDifference`, `negativePart_pointDifference`.

summary: The file spells out `positivePart`/`negativePart` for the same lattice-group object that Mathlib and the adjacent `WeilDivisor.Order` file both name `posPart`/`negPart`, breaking naming consistency. Notation is unchanged and otherwise fine.
